tour.adminDeal.priceBreakup.title: Selling Price & GST Breakup
tour.adminDeal.priceBreakup.description: Yahan customer se liya gaya total selling price clearly dikh raha hai. Is total mein taxable base aur 18% GST ka breakup alag se samajh sakte hain. GST ko dobara add nahi kiya jata.
tour.adminDeal.priceBreakup.action: Gross selling price aur GST breakup ko verify karein before closing the deal.
tour.adminDeal.commission.title: Services & Referral Commissions
tour.adminDeal.commission.description: Is section mein deal se related service charges, referral commission aur applicable partner payouts alag buckets mein dikhte hain. Isse har earning aur payout ko trace karna easy hota hai.
tour.adminDeal.commission.action: Har commission bucket ko check karein aur dekhein ki payout kis reason se create hua hai.
tour.adminDeal.profitWaterfall.title: Where Does the Profit Go?
tour.adminDeal.profitWaterfall.descripti: Yahan selling price se step-by-step samajh sakte hain ki product cost, services, commissions aur reserves ke baad business ke paas actual net pocket profit kitna bachta hai.
tour.adminDeal.profitWaterfall.action: Profit ka detailed breakup dekhne ke liye is section ko tap karke expand karein.
tour.adminDeal.sendCustomer.title: Send Revised Quote to Customer
tour.adminDeal.sendCustomer.description: Discount verify karne aur target margins check karne ke baad yahan se revised quote customer ko instant approval ke liye share karein.
tour.adminDeal.sendCustomer.action: Discount final hone par customer approval link generate ya send karein.
tour_wz_setup_desc: Answer 4 simple questions about your property and camera counts. Our AI automatically builds a 100% compatible package with genuine hardware and 18% GST.
tour_wz_setup_action: Tap Guided Setup to start, or tap Next to see Custom Build.
tour_wz_type_desc: Wired (HD/IP) runs heavy-duty cables for 24x7 uninterrupted surveillance with DVR/NVR hard disk storage. Wireless uses Wi-Fi with local SD card backup.
tour_wz_type_action: Select Wired Setup for top reliability, or Wireless for zero cabling.
tour_wz_out_desc: Outdoor bullet cameras feature IP67 weatherproof metal/ABS housings to withstand heavy rain, direct sunlight, and dust.
tour_wz_out_action: Use '+' or '-' to count your boundary walls, gates, and parking areas.
tour_wz_in_desc: Indoor dome cameras mount flush on ceilings for sleek aesthetics in living rooms, bedrooms, offices, and billing counters.
tour_wz_in_action: Adjust the count for your rooms and internal coverage areas.
tour_wz_tech_desc: Standard HD offers best budget value over copper cable. Digital IP provides future-proof 4K digital clarity with PoE network wiring.
tour_wz_tech_action: Pick your preferred technology to see live quotation options.
tour_wz_site_desc: Specifying your building type and floor layout ensures we calculate the exact cabling length and mounting accessories with zero hidden costs.
tour_wz_quote_desc: Every quotation is 100% GST-paid (18% inclusive standard) with installation included. You will see authentic Brand & Resolution packages instantly.
tour_wz_quote_action: Tap to unlock your instant quotation packages.
tour_cust_amc_desc: View your active AMC coverage, scheduled technician preventive maintenance (PM) visits, and renewal dates to keep your CCTV running 24x7 without downtime.
tour_cust_amc_action: Manage or renew your AMC contracts.
tour_cust_inv_desc: Download formal tax invoices with statutory GSTIN breakdown, serial numbers, and 1 to 3-year manufacturer warranty certificates anytime.
tour_cust_inv_action: Access your billing and warranty records.
tour_cust_ticket_desc: Experiencing offline cameras, blurry night vision, or need mobile app reconfiguration? Raise a priority support ticket for technician dispatch within 4 hours.
tour_cust_ticket_action: Tap to raise a service request.
tour.installerJob.status.title: Job & Site Overview
tour.installerJob.status.description: Yahan customer details, property address, aur job status check karein. Kaam start karne se pehle customer details aur dispatch notes verify karein.
tour.installerJob.status.action: Customer location aur property requirements check karein.
tour.installerJob.deviceScan.title: Scan Every Camera
tour.installerJob.deviceScan.description: Har installed camera ka serial number aur MAC address barcode scanner se capture karein. Isse hardware ka exact installation record maintain hota hai.
tour.installerJob.deviceScan.action: Tour complete hone ke baad Scan Barcode button tap karke camera label scan karein.
tour.installerJob.photos.title: Take Installation Photos
tour.installerJob.photos.description: Installation ke important proof photos upload karein—camera ka Bullet angle, DVR/NVR rack aur power supply. Ye photos installation quality aur future warranty activation ke kaam aate hain.
tour.installerJob.photos.action: Clear photos upload karein jisme camera angle aur wiring placement clearly dikhe.
tour.installerJob.completionPin.title: Customer Completion PIN
tour.installerJob.completionPin.descript: Final handoff aur live camera display test karne ke baad hi customer se 4-digit Secret Completion PIN lekar job sign-off complete karein.
tour.installerJob.completionPin.action: Customer ko live display dikhaane ke baad Request Signoff par tap karein.
tour.partnerCommissions.summary.title: Total Earnings & Payout Status
tour.partnerCommissions.summary.descript: Yahan total earned, pending payout aur paid commission clearly segregated hai. B2C referrals par ₹500 fixed reward aur B2B projects par slab-based earnings yahan calculate hoti hain.
tour.partnerCommissions.summary.action: Pending aur Paid amounts ko verify karein.
tour.partnerCommissions.ledger.title: Commission Ledger & TDS Details
tour.partnerCommissions.ledger.descripti: Har deal ke against gross commission amount, applicable 5% TDS deduction aur bank transfer status transparently line-by-line track kiya jata hai.
tour.partnerCommissions.ledger.action: Order reference aur payment settlement date check karein.
tour.partnerLeads.submit.title: Register a New Customer
tour.partnerLeads.submit.description: Yahan se apne reference ke new customer details register karein. Register hote hi automatic quote tracking start ho jati hai.
tour.partnerLeads.submit.action: Customer ka naam, mobile number aur property type enter karein.
tour.partnerLeads.list.title: Track Live Quotations & Status
tour.partnerLeads.list.description: Apne register kiye gaye sabhi customers ka live quote status, payable amount aur installation progress yahan real-time dekh sakte hain.
tour.partnerLeads.list.action: Customer status (Quoted, Site Visit, Won) check karein.
tour_cat_tech_desc: Switch between Standard HD (copper wiring for best budget value), Digital IP (Cat6 network cable for 4K digital crispness), Smart Wi-Fi (no video cables), or Hybrid Pro (mixed setup).
tour_cat_tech_action: Tap any technology tab to see how package hardware and pricing update live.
tour_cat_brand_desc: Select genuine brands like CP Plus, Hikvision, Dahua, or Trueview. We never mix unbranded hardware—every camera is authentic with official brand warranty.
tour_cat_brand_action: Use the dropdown to filter by your preferred brand.
tour_cat_storage_desc: Choose how many days of continuous 24x7 video you need (7, 15, 30, or 60 days). We automatically calculate the correct hard drive capacity with auto-overwrite.
tour_cat_drive_desc: CCTV requires dedicated surveillance hard drives (WD Purple or Seagate SkyHawk) engineered for continuous 24/7 video write cycles, not ordinary PC drives.
tour_cat_drive_action: Check your surveillance hard disk specifications.
tour_cat_card_desc: Every card represents a real hardware package derived from Brand + Resolution + Technology. The price displayed includes 18% GST and installation—zero hidden surprises.
tour_cat_match_desc: Have an offline or competitor quotation? Tap
tour_cat_match_action: Tap to upload or share any competitor quote.
tour_rev_gst_desc: The gross price you see includes 18% GST and installation. Taxable Base + 18% GST reconciles mathematically to ₹0.00 drift—no hidden taxes or added fees at checkout.
tour_rev_bom_desc: Check every item in your installation: camera models, DVR/NVR recorder, dedicated surveillance hard drive, power supplies, weatherproof junction boxes, and cabling.
tour_rev_wa_desc: Tap the WhatsApp button to instantly receive your formal GST quotation and technical specification PDF directly on your smartphone.
tour_rev_wa_action: Tap to send quotation to your WhatsApp.
tour_rev_book_desc: Book your physical site survey with our verified CCTV engineer. We verify cable routes, test power points, and confirm camera angles before final mounting.
tour_rev_book_action: Tap to schedule your site visit.
tour_track_stage_desc: Track your job live across 5 milestones: Order Placed → Materials Dispatched → Technician En-Route → Installation in Progress → Tested & Completed.
tour_track_stage_action: Monitor your installation progress in real-time.
tour_track_tech_desc: Directly call or WhatsApp your assigned senior CCTV installer. Every technician is police-verified, background-checked, and equipped with testing monitors.
tour_track_tech_action: Tap to connect with your installer.
tour_track_otp_desc: For your security, a job is only marked completed after you verify live mobile phone viewing, camera angles, and share the 4-digit completion OTP with the technician.
tour_track_otp_action: Share OTP only after full testing and satisfaction.
tour_wz_custom_desc: Already know your exact brands (CP Plus, Hikvision, Dahua) and specifications? Custom Build lets you directly customize every camera, brand, and storage drive in our open catalog.
tour_wz_custom_action: Tap Custom Build if you prefer picking your own hardware.
tour_wz_storage_desc: Choose how many days of continuous recording you need (7, 15, 30, or 60 days). We pair authentic surveillance drives (WD Purple / Seagate SkyHawk) engineered for continuous video write.
tour_wz_app_desc: All packages include lifetime free mobile app setup for Android and iOS with multi-phone access for your family or staff.
tour_wz_app_action: Review your remote phone viewing options.
